description: Web3 marketing compliance wordlist. Each entry is a case-insensitive regex checked against the deliverable. Severity 'fail' blocks the verify gate; 'warn' surfaces without blocking. Tune per client/jurisdiction.

patterns.label: Guaranteed returns claim
patterns.why: Promissory financial claim — regulators treat this as a financial promotion red flag.

patterns.label: Risk-free claim
patterns.why: No crypto product is risk-free; this phrasing invites regulatory action.

patterns.label: Multiplier price talk
patterns.why: Price-performance promises read as investment advice.

patterns.label: Moon talk
patterns.why: Hype phrasing that signals price speculation to regulators and platforms.

patterns.label: Financial advice mention
patterns.why: Even 'not financial advice' jokes draw scrutiny; counsel should review any advice framing.

patterns.label: Direct token buy call
patterns.why: Direct solicitation to purchase a token.
